#Added by UNNEWS
#
# Two confirmed reasons for this block, from the team:
# (1) prevent crawlers getting stuck in Search API Facets combinations
#     (?f[0]=date:2020, stackable, going back to 2001)
# (2) these are list/aggregator pages, and the same content they list
#     is already indexed individually elsewhere (e.g. each story has
#     its own /story/ URL) -- the list views themselves were judged to
#     have no SEO relevance and were intentionally excluded from the
#     index, including their region/topic sub-listings, which are also
#     just filtered re-lists of already-indexed content, not distinct
#     content in their own right.
#
# Restored the original broad subtree blocks (moved to root, where
# they'll actually be enforced for the first time) to satisfy (2), and
# kept the global facet/pagination rules below as defense-in-depth for
# (1) on any page/section not explicitly listed here, including future
# ones if Facets gets added elsewhere.
Disallow: */news/
Disallow: */features*
Disallow: */interviews*

# Extends the same "list page, no SEO relevance, duplicates already-
# indexed content" reasoning to /audio-hub -- a paginated list of
# /audio-product/ shows, which are themselves already indexed
# individually. Not in the original UNNEWS block (site added this
# section later); added here for consistency with the stated intent.
Disallow: */audio-hub*

# Global facet rule -- defense-in-depth per (1) above, covers any
# ?f[0]=... combination site-wide, including sections not explicitly
# blocked above.
Disallow: /*?f%5B0%5D=

# Global pagination rule -- same crawl-budget reasoning as facets,
# covers ?page=N site-wide.
Disallow: /*?page=

Disallow: */views/ajax

# Intentionally broad/unanchored: every /*/tags/{term} page is an
# individually auto-generated, thin tag-archive page -- the rule's
# purpose is to block all of them.
Disallow: */tags/

Disallow: */search/

# /*/audio-product/* pages are NOT list/aggregator pages -- confirmed
# each show (un-news-today, podcast-the-lid-is-on, focus-gender,
# un-and-africa, podcast-classics) is the unique, primary content
# itself, not a re-listing of content indexed elsewhere. Neither stated
# rationale ((1) facets or (2) duplicate list pages) applies to these
# URLs, so they stay crawlable. Their own pagination/facet variants (if
# any) are still covered by the two global rules above.

#Allow Podcast Feed Fetcher Agents
User-agent: Feedfetcher-Google
Allow: /feed/subscribe/

# No Sitemap directive existed before. There is no single root
# sitemap.xml -- each locale has its own sitemap index (Simple XML
# Sitemap module). en/ar/zh/ru/fr/sw verified live; es/pt/hi/ur
# assumed to follow the same per-locale pattern -- confirm before
# relying on it.
Sitemap: https://news.un.org/en/sitemap.xml
